provenance.statement: This companion inherits the primary record provenance and adds no hardware measurement.

measurement_scope: All quality, throughput, and L1 values below are mechanically derived from the final primary record; the preflight-rejected row has no device result.

definitions.phase_sensitive_complex_response_relativ: ||response_candidate - response_reference||_F / ||response_reference||_F; complex phase and response scale are retained
definitions.phase_aligned_complex_response_relative_: Fit alpha = vdot(response_candidate, response_reference) / vdot(response_candidate, response_candidate), then report ||alpha * response_candidate - response_reference||_F / ||response_reference||_F
definitions.db_pattern: Normalize candidate and reference magnitudes separately by each look's sampled look-direction magnitude; compare 20*log10(max(magnitude, 10**(floor_db/20))) using RMS and maximum absolute dB error; floor_db=-120 by default

supersedes.scope: The 2026-10-09 retake JSON, summary JSON, L1-accounting JSON, and companion CSV remain immutable historical artifacts.

power_snapshot.coverage_definition: Coverage is complete when the immutable per-run snapshot has at least one usable finite telemetry row, usable timestamps parse in order, its first usable sample is at or before the recorded run start, and its last usable sample timestamp is at or after the recorded run end; the run interval is covered through its end. Rows with unusable power, AICLK, or temperature values are excluded from these checks.

notes: The primary record is the byte-preserved measurement authority; this file is a derived companion.
FP32-R quality reductions are reported as BF16-R minus FP32-R; throughput and L1 costs are FP32-R minus BF16-R.
The expected FP32-R/L32/R-in-L1 row remains a zero-launch preflight rejection and is included only in the L1 ledger.
